Innere Stadt (01. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

Average day Average night

In detail

Vienna's historic 1st district is not associated with violent crime in local press, but 2024 police statistics reported by meinbezirk.at showed pickpocketing rising from 1,160 to 1,290 cases and car break-ins nearly doubling (101 to 191), attributed to the district's dense concentration of tourists, transit hubs and nightlife. A 2025 city-wide ranking (oe24) put Innere Stadt fifth among Vienna's 23 districts by absolute crime count (10,130 offences in 2024), though this reflects extremely high foot traffic rather than a violent-crime pattern; residential burglaries in the district actually fell. City-wide surveys cited by vienna.at found 75% of Viennese feel safe, versus 87% in the rest of Austria, underlining a gap between statistics and perception. No specific no-go streets or serious/violent incidents tied to the Innere Stadt were found in current press; the concern documented is petty theft and scams around crowded tourist areas, relevant both day and night. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, May 2025; oe24.at, April 2025; vienna.at, November 2025.
